  • Classes in org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp used by org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp
    Class
    Description
    McpChangeEvent
    A single revision-neutral change event published through McpSubscriptions and fanned out by an McpSubscriptionBroker to every matching McpSubscription.
    McpChangeKind
    The kind of change a neutral MCP subscription can be notified about.
    McpCompleter
    Application behavior invoked for a completion/complete request against a declared prompt argument (McpPromptArgument.getCompleter()) or resource-template variable (McpResourceTemplateHandler.completer(String)).
    McpCompletionRef
    Revision-neutral identification of the declaration a completion/complete request targets.
    McpCompletionRef.Kind
    The kind of declaration a McpCompletionRef targets.
    McpCompletionRequest
    Revision-neutral invocation of an McpCompleter.
    McpCompletionResult
    Revision-neutral, as-returned-by-the-application result of an McpCompleter invocation.
    McpCompletionResult.Normalized
    The normalized shape of a completion result, ready for wire mapping.
    McpContentBlock
    Revision-neutral content block returned by tool calls and prompt messages.
    McpContentBlock.Kind
    Which content variant is populated.
    McpCursor
    Pagination strategy for MCP list dispatchers (tools / prompts / resources / resource templates).
    McpDispatchResult
    The non-notification result of one McpRevision.dispatch(McpExchange, McpServerConfig, org.apache.juneau.commons.inject.BeanStore) call: either a complete JSON-RPC response envelope (McpResponseResult) or a held-open streaming publisher (McpStreamResult, for a revision-specific method whose successful result is not a single JSON-RPC envelope, e.g. the 2026-07-28 subscriptions/listen method).
    McpErrorKind
    Revision-neutral classification of a dispatch failure.
    McpExchange
    The inbound JSON-RPC envelope plus request-header access, with no servlet or HTTP types attached.
    McpPage
    Slice of MCP descriptors returned by McpCursor.page(List, String, org.apache.juneau.commons.inject.BeanStore).
    McpPromptArgument
    Revision-neutral declared argument of a prompt.
    McpPromptHandler
    Handler for a single MCP prompt.
    McpPromptMessage
    Revision-neutral single message within a prompt result.
    McpPromptOutcome
    Revision-neutral result of a prompts/get invocation.
    McpPromptSpec
    Revision-neutral prompt descriptor returned from prompts/list.
    McpResourceContents
    Revision-neutral resource payload, either inline text or a base64 blob.
    McpResourceContents.Kind
    Which payload variant is populated.
    McpResourceHandler
    Handler for a single MCP resource.
    McpResourceOutcome
    Revision-neutral result of a resources/read invocation.
    McpResourceSpec
    Revision-neutral resource descriptor returned from resources/list.
    McpResourceTemplateHandler
    Handler for a single MCP resource template.
    McpResourceTemplateHandler.ReadFunction
    A three-argument function from (uri, variables, ctx) to a McpResourceOutcome, matching McpResourceTemplateHandler.ReadFunction.read(String, Map, BeanStore)'s signature.
    McpResourceTemplateSpec
    Revision-neutral resource-template descriptor returned from resources/templates/list.
    McpRevision
    Service-provider interface implemented once per MCP protocol revision.
    McpRole
    Revision-neutral role for McpPromptMessage entries.
    McpSchema
    Revision-neutral carrier for a tool's input schema.
    McpServerConfig
    Aggregate configuration consumed by the bound McpRevision.
    McpServerConfig.ResourceTemplateMatch
    The result of McpServerConfig.resolveResourceTemplate(String): the winning resource-template handler paired with the variables decoded from the concrete request URI.
    McpSubscription
    Per-subscription queue handle minted by an McpSubscriptionBroker.
    McpSubscriptionBroker
    Revision-neutral registry + filtered fan-out publisher for MCP subscriptions/listen.
    McpSubscriptionFilter
    A revision-neutral, immutable subscription filter: the set of change kinds and resource URIs one McpSubscription is interested in.
    McpSubscriptions
    App-facing, revision-neutral change-publish SPI for MCP subscriptions/listen.
    McpToolHandler
    Handler for a single MCP tool.
    McpToolOutcome
    Revision-neutral result of a tools/call invocation.
    McpToolSpec
    Revision-neutral tool descriptor returned from tools/list.
    McpTypedToolHandler
    Strongly-typed tool handler whose argument and result Java types drive schema derivation and binding.
    McpUriTemplateMatcher
    Hand-rolled, dependency-free compiler and reverse matcher for the narrow, reliably-invertible subset of RFC 6570 URI templates used by MCP resource-template reads.
